I have used the IT Cosmetics Confidence in A Cream for a couple years now and I really like the brand, so I was excited to try the Bye Bye Dark Spots Niacinamide serum. This product can help reduce and prevent fine lines and wrinkles, improve skin elasticity and firmness because it contains niacinamide. It helps the skin to repair sun damage, calm down inflammation and maintain a good level of moisture. This product did all of these things for me! Obviously, using the product for several weeks will show you all the results, but right away my skin felt like it was more hydrated. The only draw back is it can be harsh for sensitive skin, which I have, so I only use it about twice a week and that seems to do the trick. The serum goes on easy and isn't sticky or leaves a residue. Also, it has a pleasant smell which isn't overbearing, so people sensitive to smells this might be a good option for you. I plan on keeping this in my skincare routine for a long time!

I really enjoyed using the It Cosmetics Bye Bye Dark Spot Concentrated Derma Serum because of its lovely formula. I like the dropper bottle as it makes it very easy to get and dispense product. The serum has a medium-weight texture, not too heavy yet not lightweight either. There is no hyaluronic acid in this serum, but the slight tacky and moisturizing formula feels similar to other hyaluronic serums I have tried. The 2 main ingredients in this serum are 4% niacinamide to help reduce dark spots and 1% ethyl vitamin C to improve skin clarity and get rid of dullness. Within the 7 days of using this serum day and night, I have definitely noticed a drastic brightening effect when I wake up in the morning and an overall glow to my skin. Within the 7 days of using it, I do not think that dark spots were removed but it might have been lightened a bit. I believe results will become more dramatic within 1-2 month's continued use. I really enjoy this serum with ethyl vitamin C because it is MORE stable and less irritating than ascorbic acid and because it is water and oil soluble - it can penetrate the skin much better. Ultimately, this serum will help fade many dark spots but the most stubborn ones will require some sort of laser treatment to fully remove. There is a strong fragrance to this serum, it reminds me of a nice shampoo scent. It does not bother me at all but may be a purchasing factor for those with more sensitive skin. This serum is definitely worth repurchasing for me as
